patch_description: This redesign uses an input-derived beam/archive pipeline rather than a single repair trajectory. It first creates multiple C4-free scaffolds by retaining differently ordered subsets of the input edges, then completes each scaffold with an exact length-three-path legality test and a future-loss heuristic. An elite archive is improved through bounded obstruction-aware edge deletions followed by tabu refill. Every stage explicitly checks the common-neighbor invariant before candidates are retained or returned.
